items.source: Auto-configuration for RSocketGraphQlClient. This auto-configuration creates RSocketGraphQlClient.Builder prototype beans, as the builders are stateful and should not be reused to build client instances with different configurations.
items.translation: 自动配置 用于 RSocketGraphQlClient。此自动配置创建 RSocketGraphQlClient.Builder 原型 Bean，因为构建器是状态化的，不应重用它们来构建具有不同配置的客户端实例。
